links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT-4o responses to labor epidural analgesia questions
links.effect: Mean readability indices rated fairly difficult to very difficult, corresponding to US grade level 11th grade to college entry; accuracy 97.7% ± 8.1%.
links.quote: The mean readability indices of the ChatGPT-4o responses to the questions were generally rated as fairly difficult to very difficult, which corresponded to a US grade level between 11th grade to college level entry.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education responses versus appropriate level
links.effect: Responses were fairly to very difficult to read, at 11th grade to college entry US grade level.
links.quote: The mean readability indices of the ChatGPT-4o responses to the questions were generally rated as fairly difficult to very difficult, which corresponded to a US grade level between 11th grade to college level entry.
